bass.tags: Lo-fi hip hop. A Rhodes electric piano plays a four-bar loop of jazz-influenced seventh chords with a subtle tremolo effect and high-frequency roll-off. The drum kit consists of a muffled, thumping kick drum, a crisp snare with a short decay, and a swung eighth-note hi-hat pattern featuring occasional open-hat accents. A warm, rounded sine-wave synth bass follows the root notes of the piano progression. A recurring vinyl crackle and hiss layer persists throughout the track. A melodic lead is provided by a muted trumpet with heavy reverb, playing short, improvisational phrases. 85 BPM. Key of C minor. 4/4 time signature.
bass.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[vinyl crackle and hiss]
[Rhodes electric piano enters with jazz chords]

[Main Section]
[muffled kick drum and swung hi-hats enter]
[snare on beats 2 and 4]
[warm sine-wave synth bass enters]
[muted trumpet with reverb plays melodic phrases]

[Outro]
[drums and bass drop out]
[Rhodes piano fades out]
[vinyl crackle continues to silence]

drums.tags: Bossa nova. Nylon string acoustic guitar plays syncopated jazz chords with a thumb-plucked bassline on beats 1 and 3. A shaker maintains a steady sixteenth-note pattern. The drum kit features a rimshot on the snare playing a bossa nova clave pattern and a soft kick drum on every beat. A clean electric guitar plays melodic lines with light reverb. Key of C major. 120 BPM. 4/4 time signature. The arrangement maintains a consistent dynamic level throughout.
drums.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[nylon string acoustic guitar, shaker]

[Main Theme]
[rimshot snare, soft kick drum, clean electric guitar melody]

[Bridge]
[acoustic guitar chord soloing]

[Outro]
[instruments fade out, final acoustic guitar chord]

vocals.tags: Bossa nova. Nylon string acoustic guitar plays syncopated jazz chords with a steady thumb-picked bassline on beats 1 and 3. A flute performs a melodic lead with frequent vibrato and grace notes. Percussion consists of a shaker playing sixteenth notes and a woodblock or rimshot hitting the clave rhythm. The tempo is 124 BPM in 4/4 time. The arrangement maintains a consistent dynamic level with the flute and guitar interlocking in a contrapuntal style. The guitar uses a standard bossa nova pattern with frequent extensions like 9ths and 13ths.
